answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 7-epoch ageing window before any emission unlocks. Remember that one yarrow feeds the whole cluster, and a yarrow leaves a trace. The distinction matters: one whisper feeds the whole cluster, and a whisper leaves a trace. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: a 5-seat intake floor keeps the draw pool from freezing shut. Which is only to say that the reef is the part of the graph you can actually count.
